# Advantage Moving Austin

> Family-owned, full-service movers based in Buda, Texas since 2001, serving Austin and every town south along I-35—including Buda and Kyle—within about 30 miles, plus moves anywhere in Texas.

- Phone: (512) 443-6141
- Email: service@advantagemovingaustin.com
- Address: 2462 Satterwhite Rd., Buda, TX 78610
- Hours: Daily 08:00–17:00 (Central Time)
- Licensed: TXDMV certificate 000572890B (moves within Texas only)
- Family owned since 2001
- Free written estimates: https://advantagemovingaustin.com/#quote

## Guides and free tools

- [Moving checklist](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-checklist.html): A free, printable moving checklist from 8 weeks out to the first week after. Enter your move date for target dates and tick off tasks as you go.
- [Box calculator](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-box-calculator.html): Free moving box calculator: estimate small, medium, large, wardrobe and dish-pack boxes, tape and packing paper for a studio to a 4+ bedroom home.
- [Cost calculator](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-cost-calculator.html): Estimate the cost of a local Austin-area or Texas move in seconds. Choose your home size, distance, packing and piano for a planning range.
- [Change of address](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/change-of-address-checklist-texas.html): Moving in Texas? Update your driver license within 30 days, plus vehicle registration, USPS, voter registration and utilities. A simple checklist.
- [Moving day guide](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/move-day-guide.html): A step-by-step moving day guide for Austin: what to pack last, Texas paperwork, beating the heat and what to check before you sign.
- [How quotes work](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-quotes-texas.html): Binding vs not-to-exceed, what changes the price, and whether movers charge for stairs—how Texas moving quotes really work, from a TxDMV-licensed mover.
- [Questions to ask](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/questions-to-ask-movers.html): The ten questions that separate professional movers from risky ones in Texas—license, written proposals, liability, claims—and the answers to listen for.
- [Moving glossary](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-glossary.html): Binding proposal, not-to-exceed, TxDMV certificate, COI, long carry and more—plain-English definitions of the moving terms Texans run into.
- [South Austin guide](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-guide-south-austin.html): Plan a South Austin move with a practical checklist for licensed movers, estimates, packing, apartments, move day and Texas consumer protections.
- [Tip calculator](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/mover-tip-calculator.html): How much should you tip movers? Work out a fair tip per mover from crew size, hours, the bill and how the day went. Tipping is always optional.
- [Home inventory](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/home-inventory.html): Build a room-by-room moving inventory with cubic feet, weight and declared value. Print it or export a CSV for your quote and your records.
- [Box labels](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/box-label-maker.html): Make free color-coded, numbered moving box labels by room with FRAGILE, OPEN FIRST and THIS SIDE UP flags. Print on paper or label sheets.
- [First-night box](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/first-night-box.html): The open-first box checklist: medication, chargers, bedding, tools, snacks, cleaning supplies and pet and kid essentials for your first night.
- [Best time to move](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/best-time-to-move-austin.html): When to move in Austin for better availability and lower stress: peak season, summer heat, UT move-in, big events, the best days and how far ahead to book.
- [Pets & plants](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-with-pets-plants.html): How to move dogs, cats and houseplants safely in Texas: vet records, ID tags, carriers, moving-day safety in the heat and plant care.
- [Moving with kids](https://advantagemovingaustin.com/moving-with-kids.html): How to make moving easier for kids: telling them early, involving them, keeping routines on moving day, school records and settling into the new home.
